working_title: Contact-Aware Cryptographic Agility for Trusted Post-Compromise Recovery in Intermittently Connected Space Systems
repository_scope: Study 8 is a separately frozen modeled companion study. It is not part of the existing Study-1/Study-2 journal manuscript unless a later publication-integration gate explicitly authorizes that change.
inference_boundary: The 3,456 positions are the complete deterministic finite factorial population defined by the frozen protocol, not a probabilistic sample. Sampling p-values, bootstrap inference, permutation inference, and sampling confidence intervals are not supported.
claim_boundary: Results describe modeled logical contact/recovery behavior and standardized cryptographic-object byte budgets only. They are not measured spacecraft, RF-link, onboard PQC execution, CPU, energy, flight, ground-station, operator, or operational CCSDS/PQC performance.
